correctness.rationale: Relations force one-nonzero-per-row P. Composition gives P²=P, R²=R, Q=QP+RQ with R entrywise P squared; the canonical root-row description proves R idempotent of equal rank r. Decomposition of domain/codomain into respective image and kernel gives exactly two free r(n−r)-dimensional Q blocks, and the independent root assignments give the displayed coefficient. The image basis and map rank are proved over arbitrary fields. All coefficient tuples checked exhaustively in five small finite-field cases using the bundled checker.

originality.rationale: The closest directly matching published algebra result determines only its invertible automorphisms. The 2024 primary paper supplies general characteristic-zero automorphism theory; earlier retract theorems cover graded or different semigroup-ring structures. None of these statements implies the complete labeled composition-idempotent rank enumerator, whose extra quadratic-lift counts are proved independently here. Search cannot rule out equivalent descriptions elsewhere.
residual_risks: An earlier unpublished or differently indexed theorem may give the same fiber-product retraction enumerator.
The literature analysis does not certify novelty against every possible monomial or finite-ring endomorphism work.

value.rationale: This full rank census is a natural invariant of split quotient structures of cubic truncated coordinate-axis algebras, the first non-square-zero thickening. It separates a combinatorial root-selection mechanism from 2r(n−r) independent nongraded quadratic lifting parameters and gives a closed count for every finite field and generator number, not a simple renaming or small isolated numerical tabulation.
